## What Is Workplace Accident Reporting?

In the workplace, an injury is usually caused by various hazards—physical, chemical, biological, or ergonomic. Employers can be legally responsible for failing to prevent these hazards in the workplace. Companies collect and analyse accident reports to understand the incident and take corrective action. Capability to detect patterns for change is much more difficult without reporting that is well-organized and precise. In fact, up to 50% of workplace accidents happen because something wasn’t reported or was misunderstood.
